# Ten real-style criteria

## Acceptance criteria

1. The chip adds at most 64px to the toolbar
2. The selection toolbar is at most 640px wide, keeps ≥4px between items glyph to glyph, never overlaps, and stays on one row at 1024px
3. Button labels are no longer than 24 characters
4. The overflow menu shows at most 5 items
5. The panel fade-in lasts no more than 200ms
6. The e2e test suite times out after at most 30s
7. The change touches at most 3 files
8. Card padding is at most 16px and at least 8px
9. The sidebar is max 280px wide
10. Sidebar nav items never overlap or truncate
11. Toolbar buttons are ≤ 32px tall
